independence_evidence: The support page says The Toe Rag is a fully independent magazine run by volunteers, with no affiliations with galleries or publishers, funded by advertising and one-off donations.
qualifies_reason: Volunteer-run independent print magazine publishing three issues a year, with Issue 8 (Decadence) distributed July 2026 and Issue 9 (Fictions) scheduled for and listed for sale from October 2026.
what_it_is: A print magazine of contemporary culture published three times a year (February, June and October) carrying essays, reviews, interviews, fiction, poetry and artists' projects, with back pages of event listings, puzzles, games and an agony aunt. Each issue has a theme (recent ones: The Pastoral, Decadence, Fictions) and it is distributed through bookshops, galleries and arts venues, mostly in London, as well as by mail order. It is for readers of art criticism and literary writing who want a newsprint-style alternative to gallery magazines.
uncertainties: The issues page says the ninth issue, Fictions, 'will be published in October 2026' and the purchase page lists Issue 9 for order ahead of Issue 8, but the same page still says Issue 8 is the issue available from stockists (restocked 22 July 2026), so Issue 9 may still be at pre-order stage; it is recorded as October 2026 from the stated schedule. The shop runs on Cargo and renders prices client-side, so no cover price could be read from the publisher's site (a stockist lists it at £6.50; the Stack profile says it is also given away free at arts venues). No image of the Issue 9 cover was found; the only cover file on the site is Issue 8 (https://freight.cargo.site/w/1200/i/A2992662081262705751179634421749/TTR_ISSUE8_COMP_S01-1.png). The site gives no postal address; London is taken from the Stack profile and the London-centred stockist list. Trim size and page count are not stated.
